graph_nodes.description: A large meta-theme in the existing school-burnout graph. It covers students' emotional suffering, distress-related depletion, and negative self-appraisal in relation to academic demands.
examples: I feel buried under assignments from every class, and no matter how much I work, the pile never seems to get smaller.
When I’m not studying, I’m still mentally studying, planning, or worrying. It’s like school has taken over all my downtime.
graph_nodes.label: Psychological and Emotional Distress

graph_nodes.description: This theme captures the psychological and physiological toll of academic demands: feeling overwhelmed or trapped, intrusive worries during rest or leisure, sleep disruption, fear of failure, shame, irritability, and strain on relationships.
examples: I tried to watch a show after dinner, but I kept thinking about the assignment I still haven’t finished.
Even my free time feels occupied by school.
graph_nodes.label: Anxiety, Stress, and Emotional Distress

graph_nodes.description: This theme captures profound physical, cognitive, and emotional depletion caused by academic demands, including feeling drained, numb, unable to rest, and unable to mentally disconnect from school.
examples: Schoolwork doesn’t feel meaningful anymore, so I procrastinate until it’s almost too late. I’m scared of failing, but I’m also tired of caring so much.
I used to like learning, and now I can barely care enough to open my notebook.
graph_nodes.label: Burnout, Exhaustion, and Fatigue

graph_nodes.description: This theme captures students interpreting academic struggles as evidence of intellectual inadequacy or inferiority. It includes eroded self-trust, peer comparison, shame, helplessness, and feeling incapable of succeeding.
examples: I try to stay on top of everything, but I keep making mistakes and it’s embarrassing. I feel weaker and less capable than the other students.
It makes me feel like I’m always behind before I even start.
graph_nodes.label: Self-Doubt, Inferiority, and Eroded Confidence
